title: 第12章 唱反调
novel_title: 听我解释，真不是你们想的那样！
content_zh:
回去的路上，庄静白一直沉默，甚至是魂不守舍。

    “娘子，你怎么了？”

    庄静白摇摇头，没说话。

    她脑海里反复浮现着厨房里那缕淡淡的清香，还有那扇紧闭的门。

    陆沉洞府里，有女人。

    而且，住了不止一天！

    回到自己的洞府里，庄静白也不知道现在自己是什么心情。

    她虽然一时糊涂做了错事，但现如今已经清醒了过来。

    可为什么，在得知陆沉洞府里住着一个女人的时候，自己心里那么难受，那么失魂落魄？

    林天和陆沉是好兄弟，从某种层面来说，自己永远也不可能有机会和陆沉在一起，那人家陆沉找个姑娘成亲，不是再正常不过的事情吗？

    为什么，自己不想看他成亲？

    难道是因为自己的新婚的盖头是他揭开的，新婚的合卺酒也是和他一起喝的，就连自己最重要的，也送给了他？

    所以从某种意义上来说，她庄静白，嫁的不是林天，而是……！

    并且……从自己犯错之后，她和他，就再也不可能了！

    想到这里，庄静白忍不住从储物袋里拿出了当时，两人一起的物品……

    陆沉的洞府里。

    他此刻正在炼化林天送给他的宝物，这是能够开出来第二个词条的好东西！

    原文里的主角林天，就是因为第二个词条（烈阳圣体），才开启了属于他的传奇一生！

    那么自己的第二个词条，会是什么呢？

    想到这里，陆沉深吸一口气，将玉牌贴在眉心，缓缓闭上眼。

    灵力涌动，玉牌化作一道流光，没入他的识海。

    轰！！

    脑海深处传来一声轰鸣，像是有什么东西被撕裂，又像是有什么东西在生长。陆沉只觉得浑身上下每一寸血肉都在震颤，每一个细胞都在欢呼。

    这种感觉……比突破境界还要奇妙。

    不知过了多久，震颤渐渐平息。

    陆沉睁开眼，眼底闪过一丝期待。

    他闭上眼，内视识海。

    在那里，原本孤零零悬浮着的【一击必中】词条旁边，多了一个新的光点。

    陆沉屏住呼吸，将神识探过去。

    光点散开，化作几个古朴的文字。

    【唱反调】

    陆沉愣住了。
content_en:
On the way back, Zhuang Jingbai remained silent, even distracted.

"Madam, what's wrong with you?"

Zhuang Jingbai shook his head and said nothing.

The faint fragrance in the kitchen and the closed door repeatedly appeared in her mind.

There is a woman in Lu Shen Cave Mansion.

Moreover, I stayed for more than one day!

Back in his cave, Zhuang Jingbai didn't know how he felt now.

Although she was confused and did something wrong for a while, she has now sobered up.

But why did I feel so uncomfortable and lost when I learned that there was a woman living in Luchendong Mansion?

Lin Tian and Lu Chen are good brothers. From a certain perspective, he will never have the chance to be with Lu Chen. So isn't it normal for Lu Chen to find a girl to get married?

Why don't you want to see him get married?

Could it be because he took off his wedding hijab, drank the wedding wine with him, and even gave him the most important thing?

So in a sense, she, Zhuang Jingbai, is not marrying Lin Tian, ​​but...!

And... ever since she made a mistake, she and him are no longer possible!

Thinking of this, Zhuang Jingbai couldn't help but take out the items that the two of them shared at the time from the storage bag...

In Lu Chen's cave.

He is currently refining the treasure given to him by Lin Tian. This is a good thing that can produce a second entry!

The protagonist Lin Tian in the original article started his legendary life because of the second entry (Holy Body of the Fierce Sun)!

So what will be my second entry?

Thinking of this, Lu Chen took a deep breath, placed the jade plaque between his eyebrows, and slowly closed his eyes.

Spiritual power surged, and the jade tablet turned into a stream of light and submerged into his sea of ​​consciousness.

boom!!

There was a roar in the depths of my mind, as if something was being torn apart, or something was growing.Lu Chen felt that every inch of flesh and blood in his body was trembling, and every cell was cheering.

This feeling... is even more wonderful than breaking through the realm.

After an unknown amount of time, the tremors gradually subsided.

Lu Chen opened his eyes, a trace of expectation flashed in his eyes.

He closed his eyes and looked inside at the sea of ​​consciousness.

There, there was a new light spot next to the entry that was originally floating alone [One hit is sure to hit].

Lu Chen held his breath and probed with his spiritual consciousness.

The light spots spread out and turned into a few simple words.

【Singing the opposite tune】

Lu Chen was stunned.
